label: class_b_02_math_01
text: Hello, everyone. Let’s have a fun class today.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_02
text: Tell me, do you all enjoy shopping?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_03
text: Buying tasty bread or choosing new clothes—\neven just window shopping is so much fun![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_04
text: In today’s class, I’d like to use shopping—one of\nmy own favorite hobbies, mind you—to teach\r\nyou all about math![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_05
text: I’m sure everyone here has visited a Poké Mart at\nleast once. They sell all sorts of Pokémon items![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_06
text: Poké Balls are one of the many useful items you\ncan find there. They cost 200 each.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_07
text: Now then, I’d like you all to do some thinking\nwith me here![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_08
text: One Poké Ball is 200. If you had 2,000 and\nbought as many Poké Balls as you could afford,\r\nhow many would you receive?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_select_01
text: Nine

label: class_b_02_select_02
text: Ten

label: class_b_02_select_03
text: Eleven

label: class_b_02_math_answer_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh, my. That guess falls a little short,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_answer_02
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh dear. I’m sorry, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
I suppose
this
was
a bit
of a
trick question.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_answer_03
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]That’s correct! Well done,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_09
text: With 2,000, you can afford to purchase a\nmaximum of 10 Poké Balls...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_10
text: However! If you purchase 10 or more of any one\ntype of Poké Ball...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_11
text: You will also receive one Premier Ball—a special\nwhite ball—as a bonus![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_12
text: So the correct answer is, in fact, 11![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_13
text: It sure is nice to get a little bonus like that on a\nshopping trip, isn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_14
text: Oh, my. Is that the bell? I suppose that’s all for\nnow. What a shame...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: class_b_02_math_15
text: I’m looking forward to seeing you all in the next\nclass. I hope you’re looking forward to it, too![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
